note: A binds the sheet's main elevation dimensions more faithfully (W1 width 9'-11 1/4" in the West Bedroom view, East Bedroom 8'-8 3/8", West Living 13'-3 3/4", North Living 9'-11 1/2") and keeps the 1/2"=1'-0" scales tied to the correct views. B invents P3 offsets (7", 4 1/4", 7'-2 1/2" with a made-up 'floor/base to P3' condition) and a W2 'depth' of 4 1/2" that an elevation cannot show, and it duplicates the 13'-3 3/4" dimension as a second vague claim. Both sets misplace values across views (A: 9'-2 3/4" to a non-existent 'Elevation E', 7'-6" to North Bedroom, 2 5/8" to North Living; B: 1'-5 3/4" to North Living, 9'-10 1/4" to North Bedroom) and pad with trivial 'presence/installed' claims the quotes do not support. A's remaining claims are on balance more correctly bound and less speculative, so A is the better set.
